name: cognitive-mirror
description: A local-first second brain: ingests your activity into a self-managing knowledge graph that Claude can reason over.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n graph,ingest,daemon,mcp -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @cm/graph-core dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/ingestion dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/reasoning-daemon dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/mcp-server dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n graph,ingest,daemon,mcp,vis -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @cm/graph-core dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/ingestion dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/reasoning-daemon dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/mcp-server dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/visualiser dev"
scripts.reset: pnpm --filter @cm/graph-core reset && rm -f .data/queue.sqlite .data/queue.sqlite-shm .data/queue.sqlite-wal .data/budget.json && echo 'fresh start — graph + queue + budget cleared'
